kpis.label: Projected global space economy, from ~$470–626B in 2026

SpaceX (SPCX) briefly fell more than 20% below its $135 IPO price on Jul 28 before rebounding to ~$108-112; now down ~52% from its $225.64 post-IPO high; ~$1.43T market cap. First earnings report as a public company due Aug 4

Space Capital-tracked investment surpassed all of 2025; satellite-specific investment hit a record $8.1B in H1, with infrastructure posting a record $20.7B Q2 — Iceye's $1.2B Series F led the quarter's deals

Starlink active subscribers, +105% YoY; ARPU had slid to $66 (from $86) before SpaceX raised plan prices up to $10/month in May to reverse the trend; Quilty Space still projects ~16.8M subs by year-end 2026

tiers.label: Scale Players
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Launch monopoly economics + Starlink (10.3M subs, ARPU $66, rebounding off a May price hike); won an $1.6B Space Force order (Jul 29) for 18 Falcon 9 launches through 2027 carrying SBST early-warning satellites; stock briefly dipped 20% below its $135 IPO price Jul 28, ~$1.43T mkt cap
rows.watch for: First public-company earnings report Aug 4; August/September lockup expirations; Starship cadence after a mid-July test flight abort (engine ignition failure)

rows.angle: Agreed to acquire Iridium for ~$8B cash+stock ($54/share — $27 cash plus RKLB stock; closing targeted mid-2027); record Q1 revenue of $200.3M, 2026 guidance raised to $914M with a $2.2B+ backlog incl. 5 Neutron launch agreements; completed a 5.5-min Archimedes engine hot fire Jul 13
rows.watch for: Q2 earnings Aug 10 (per Motley Fool, the key number to watch); Neutron debut targeted Q4 2026; Iridium deal financing/regulatory approval

rows.angle: Awarded $955M by SDA (Jul 13) for 18 more Golden Dome Tranche 3 missile-tracking satellites, part of a $1.75B round (with Sierra Space) that brings total Tranche 3 to 104 spacecraft
rows.watch for: Further SDA/missile-tracking award flow; 2028 launch readiness

tiers.label: Growth / Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Direct-to-phone satellite broadband; BlueBirds 11-13 launching Aug 5 from Cape Canaveral (production through satellite 42); reaffirmed $150-200M 2026 revenue guidance with nearly 60 MNO partners covering 3B+ subscribers
rows.watch for: Aug 5 launch outcome; Aug 10 quarterly call; $1B convertible note dilution overhang

rows.angle: Lunar landers + NASA services; 2026 revenue guidance up to $1B, backlog ~$943M anchored by NASA/defense; shares (~$12) remain well off their spring highs after July's drawdown
rows.watch for: Mission success/failure binary risk; stock stabilization

rows.angle: Earth-observation data subscription model; ~6% weight in the Procure Space ETF (UFO); shares ~$20, earlier-stage with a longer runway to profitability
Space infrastructure components; shares ~$8.55, roughly +80% YTD; delivered a MANUS lunar robotic-arm prototype and won a nav-tech contract on NASA's Dragonfly (Titan) mission

private_watchlist.name: Blue Origin
private_watchlist.note: Recovering from the May 28 New Glenn pad explosion; second-stage hot fires moved to NASA Stennis' B-2 stand in July as Launch Complex 36 repairs continue. NASA's Isaacman says New Glenn remains "Plan A" for an Mk 1 launch before year-end.

private_watchlist.name: Firefly Aerospace
private_watchlist.note: Record 2025 revenue of $159.9M (+163% YoY); landed a $75M NASA JPL subcontract for the "MoonFall" Moon Base mission; Blue Ghost Mission 2 targets a lunar far-side landing plus an ESA relay satellite deployment later in 2026.

private_watchlist.name: Stoke Space
private_watchlist.note: One of five firms (with SpaceX, ULA, Blue Origin, Rocket Lab) eligible for national-security launch missions; converting Cape Canaveral LC-14 for Nova's first flight, planned later in 2026; still named as a possible acquisition target amid AST SpaceMobile's capital raise.

bear_case.title: Capital intensity
bear_case.description: Rockets and constellations burn billions before returns; dilution is chronic among small caps.

bear_case.title: Government concentration
bear_case.description: Much of the sector's revenue is NASA/DoD; budget shifts reprice backlogs fast.

bear_case.title: SpaceX absorbs the value
bear_case.description: A dominant incumbent with launch-cost leverage can compress everyone else's margins — and SpaceX itself briefly traded below its $135 IPO price on Jul 28 (now ~$1.43T mkt cap, down ~52% from its post-IPO high), with 2025 free cash flow of -$13.8B, Q1 2026 FCF of -$9.1B, and Starlink ARPU that only recently began recovering from a slide to $66 (from $86) after a May price hike.

bear_case.title: Binary mission risk
bear_case.description: One failed landing or launch can halve a small-cap (see lunar-lander names); SpaceX's own prospectus flags "key man" dependence on Elon Musk.

catalysts.title: AST SpaceMobile launches BlueBirds 11-13
catalysts.description: Three next-gen BlueBird satellites — nearly double the peak download speed of earlier units — lift off from Cape Canaveral, with a quarterly business update call to follow Aug 10.

catalysts.title: SpaceX reports first earnings as a public company
catalysts.description: The results, due one day after this edition, will be the first look at quarterly financials since the June IPO and a key test for a stock trading well below its post-IPO high.

catalysts.title: SpaceX wins $1.6B Space Force launch order
catalysts.description: Two task orders cover 18 Falcon 9 launches through 2027 carrying Space-Based Sensing and Targeting satellites, reinforcing SpaceX's hold on national-security launch.

catalysts.title: SpaceX briefly dips below its IPO price
catalysts.description: SPCX fell more than 20% under its $135 IPO price intraday before rebounding; Rocket Lab and AST SpaceMobile also sold off (-9% and -7%) in a broader sector pullback.

catalysts.title: Rocket Lab draws fresh buyers on Air Force win + Iridium news
catalysts.description: A U.S. Air Force contract win landed alongside continued follow-through on the Iridium acquisition, pulling traders back into RKLB after early-July weakness.

catalysts.title: SDA awards $1.75B for Golden Dome Tranche 3; Rocket Lab completes Archimedes hot fire
catalysts.description: L3Harris and Sierra Space split $1.75B to build 36 more missile-tracking satellites (bringing Tranche 3 to 104), while Rocket Lab completed a 5.5-minute Neutron second-stage engine test the same week.

etfs.name: Procure Space
